review.reason: The mapped course layout, hazards, tees, and greens are represented clearly, but Hole 1's fairway uses a checkerboard pattern instead of clearly defined edge-to-edge mowing bands.

issues.detail: The broad Hole 1 fairway is patterned as checkerboard squares rather than distinct alternating bands crossing the fairway perpendicular to its local edges and direction of play.
issues.consequence: At overview scale, the fairway reads as a checkerboard instead of the required striped mowing pattern.
